status: Development design informed by inspected v3-v17 results; neither preregistration nor independent confirmation.
anchor: Frozen T for Binder/Wielek, original uHNDI for Mendeley; both unchanged baselines retained.

binder.features: For every band/time cell, vector of13 scalp-channel (response-baseline)/(response+baseline). Healthy template is mean of the same vectors from all20 opt5 healthy people. Two coordinates: cosine with healthy vector (zero patient norm maps0), and (patientnorm-healthynorm)/(patientnorm+healthynorm). Require nonzero healthy template norm.6views of10 fields. Includes posterior channels and prolonged response not used by the old singleT; released aggregate ITPC is not raw phase or independent trials.
binder.without_reference: Replace each two-coordinate template comparison by channel mean and population standard deviation; a representation ablation, not a matched causal estimate of healthy-reference benefit.
binder.null: One deterministic13-channel permutation per patient, applied to all its response cells before comparison with the fixed unpermuted healthy template. Preserves cell norms and channel means; artificial spatial-null, not a new physiological record.

wielek.healthy_classifier: RF only,26files matching ^[0-9]+trueVSpred.txt$; no NN/dummy or other settings
wielek.reference: Healthy file true is the independent healthy sleep annotation; pred is author's leave-healthy-subject-out RF output. Average each healthy subject's5x5 joint proportions equally, add .001uniform mass, then row-normalize to Q=P(healthytrue|healthypred). Healthy annotations train only this global calibration; no patient manual stage, eye state or clinical score is an input. Patient predictions were made by the final RF rather than each healthy LOO RF, and full-night healthy versus full-record DOC context differs. This reference shift limits interpretation.
wielek.features: Patient predicted occupancy p and legal consecutive pair joint J; convert to soft calibrated occupancy pQ and excess pair matrix Q^T[J-leftmargin*rightmargin^T]Q.5+25 fields,2views. All intervening epochs same record and consecutive; no day/night values as classifier fields, no missing-context exclusion. Soft stages are healthy-conditioned estimates, not validated true patient sleep states.
wielek.without_reference: Q=identity; same automatic occupancy and excess pair matrix.
wielek.null: Permute predicted stages within every original contiguous segment, preserving each segment's stage counts; use the same healthyQ. Never infer chronology from healthy true/pred row order.

mendeley.features: Read all original41 EDFs preload=True, original global256Hz grid and6-channel average reference. Keep original4s500microvolt QC exactly. Within every retained block, use7 overlapping1s mean-detrended periodic Hann FFT segments. For each unordered channel pair/frequency, debiased squared wPLI=(sum Imcross squared - sum Imcross^2)/(sum absImcross squared - sum Imcross^2). Imaginary cross spectrum <=1e-12 times product FFT magnitudes maps0 to remove relative floating roundoff; denominator <=1e-12 times sumabs squared maps0; retain negative bias-corrected estimates. Mean frequencies in each half-open band, then block mean/q25/q75 per15pairs and4bands=180fields,4views. Negative dWPLI is an estimator value, not negative connectivity; overlapping segments/blocks do not count as independent patients. No causal/directed or pure volume-conduction-free claim.
mendeley.marginal: Same1s FFT auto-spectrum: sum band auto-powers per channel, divided by each block's channel-average total1-30Hz power; unordered-pair arithmetic mean, followed by same mean/q25/q75 summaries=180fields. Tests phase information versus amplitude-only input.
mendeley.null: Independent uniform Fourier phase for each channel,segment,positive interior frequency; preserve original FFT magnitudes,DC and Nyquist. Calculate dWPLI with same estimator/QC/summaries. Synthetic estimator-null after referencing, not a physically validated EEG surrogate or a rerun of acquisition.
mendeley.without_reference: Identical to main: no external healthy Mendeley reference.
mendeley.cache_validation: SHA matchesv3raw EDF; every4speak and original5bandmean PSD matches v3 chronological cache; retained count matches original41-case table. New summarized features, allblockpeaks and3clean audit waveforms retained. No exclusions; no raw-data overwrite.

representation: Main, null, marginal and without-reference representations fixed before outcomes. Robust median/IQR(std/1 fallback) fitted on training patients; asinh two anchors,tanh extras. Train feature range<=1e-12*max(1,absmedian) is mapped0 for every query, preventing near-constant numerical coordinates from being amplified. All same-input comparators get exactly main60/30/180 extra fields plus both anchors and the same independent reference calibration.
algorithm: Equal-view average RBF kernel; per-view mean-squared distance, bandwidth median positive training distances (1 if constant). Center kernel by training mean only. PSD eigendecomposition, retain eigenvalues>maxeig*1e-10. With fixed asinh measurement-anchor offset, fit strictly convex RKHS ridge pair-logistic loss. Every positive-negative patient pair gets weight .1+.9exp(-anchor_gap^2/2); normalize weights to sum1. No query patient enters scaler, widths, kernel centering/eigenbasis, weights, fit or selection. Pair focus targets ambiguous anchor ranks; no guaranteed AUC gain, confidence interpretation or missing-pair deletion.
solver: Analytic gradient/Hessian damped Newton; max100iterations, gradientinf<=1e-8, Armijo1e-4,max60backtracks. Positive ridge gives unique finite minimizer. Stop and preserve artifacts on failure.
controls: Uniform pair sets all pair weights equal. Anchor-only kernel has both old anchors and no signal fields. Standalone main signature omits output anchor and uses uniform pairs, retains both anchors for declared scaling metadata only. Same-input classics and journal adaptations receive identical main features/reference, not the ablation or null features. Quality-only original4support/retention fields separate; no claim of complete confound exclusion.

etmc.views: anchors2 plus fixed cohort signal views and concatenated pseudo-view; vector adaptation, not full image method

roboss.implementation: Paper loss and Gaussian kernel with L-BFGS, not original NAG

splits: Exactly original v10 patient roles, all45/23/41retained. Independent healthy reference has no MCS/VS diagnosis or clinical testing role. No external healthy people counted in diagnostic ROC.
selection: Mean3inner-fold AUC, ties1e-12 prefer disabled correction then stronger ridge10,1,.1. Every kernel control gets same4configurations; standalone gets3ridge configurations with no disabled anchor.
metric: Mean outer-fold AUC, then5seedmean and equal-cohortmacro; no pooledOOF weakening ofT.
performance_target: Positive macro delta vsT and originaluHNDI at everyseed, positive5seedmean vsboth in everycohort; positive meanmacro vs measurement_anchor,anchor_only_kernel_rank,marginal_signature_rank,null_signature_rank and uniform_pair_rank. Report withoutreference and all journal methods; no novelty/superiority claim without supporting evidence and independent confirmation.
novelty_limit: Candidate reference-calibrated multiresolution signature and anchor-focused kernel ranking; phase estimator, healthy calibration and kernel ranking are established constituents. No constituent priority or clinical mechanism claimed. Full method contains absoluteT and fixedQC, so no end-to-end physical gain invariance claimed.
protection: Freeze code/protocol before outer evaluation. Save exact NPZ inputs and every completedfold, preservev3-v17andmanuscripts and rawsource bytes. No outcome-informed rewriting; full negative results retained. Cache feasibility does not expose diagnostic AUC.
